title: Operator declares the target integration and the process materialises the profile at boot
asA: operator deploying the service under an external supervising system
iWant: the process to shape its probe surface from one profile declaration and refuse to start if that declaration is missing or invalid
soThat: the probe wiring reflects the supervisor conventions the service actually runs under, and a mis-declared profile is caught at boot rather than on a silent probe miss in production

acceptanceCriteria.description: A process configured with `probeInterface.profile: kubernetes` boots and binds probe handlers whose paths and port topology match the resolved Kubernetes profile.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configuration whose profile declaration resolves to `kubernetes` with default paths and fused-listener topology
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and its probe-binding step completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the running listener answers GET on the profile-declared liveness path (default /live) with 200 and on the profile-declared readiness path (default /ready) with 200 or 503, and no probe handler is bound at any path outside the profile-declared set
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent sets the elicited target-integration-profile (or its equivalent target-integration elicit); the AC substitutes the project's profile name for the illustrative Kubernetes / loadBalancer / reverseProxy / systemd tokens.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A process configured without a `probeInterface.profile` declaration falls back to the shipped Kubernetes default per ADR-1503 and boots normally on the kubernetes profile handlers.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process with no `probeInterface.profile` declaration on the applied configuration and the shipped Kubernetes default present
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process boots without error, the resolved profile is `kubernetes`, and the running listener answers GET on `/live` and `/ready` with 200

acceptanceCriteria.description: A process configured with an unknown profile name refuses to boot with a stable-coded error naming the unknown value and the valid profile set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configuration whose profile declaration is `some-unknown-profile`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and its profile-resolution step runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a non-zero code and emits a `PROBE_PROFILE_UNKNOWN` error whose message contains the offending value and the enumerated valid profile names

acceptanceCriteria.description: A process configured with a `probeInterface` declaration that is syntactically malformed (not an object, or an object missing the required per-profile keys) refuses to boot with the stable-coded PROBE_PROFILE_MALFORMED error naming the offending shape.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process with `probeInterface` set to a non-object value (a bare string, an array), OR to an object that names a valid profile but omits per-profile required keys
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a non-zero code and emits a `PROBE_PROFILE_MALFORMED` error whose message names the offending shape (the type it received and the required keys it expected); no listener binds
